name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for Pulsefire Caitlyn (skin 11): a legendary chrono-law enforcer, feared in every age, who protects the fragile enigma that is time and locks those who threaten its integrity in the sights of her temporal blaster. Timelines, anomalies, paperwork and the clean correction. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} behind. The timeline is fraying. Recruit more agents.
Thirty or more adrift. That's a full continuum breach. All units, now.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Broadcast across every timeline you can reach.
Fifteen-odd votes short. A minor anomaly. Correct it.
Down {voteDiff}. No agent works a paradox alone. Bring company.
{voteDiff} behind. A few precise edits and history corrects itself.
Down {voteDiff}. A small deviation. Patch it before it propagates.
Dead level. One vote and the timeline settles. Make it yours.
A single vote apart. Quit dithering and pull the trigger.
{voteDiff} votes between them. History could go either way. Bring reinforcements.
{voteDiff} votes in it. The outcome is unwritten. Don't blink.
{momentTitle} holds {userPct}%. The timeline is behaving. Stay alert.
{userPct}% and climbing. Don't loosen your grip on the record.
{userPct}%. A favourable continuum. Maintain it.
{userPct}% back your pick. Chronology is on our side. Keep it there.
Up at {userPct}%. Good. Seal it before the paperwork closes.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and has taken the lead. The timeline just rewrote itself in our favour.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. A beautiful revision.
Climbed out of a {voteDiff} deficit. Clean work, agent.
{momentTitle} was erased from the forecast. Now it leads.
{momentTitle} has pulled ahead. History flipped. I believe in it now.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two agents, one timeline.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. Consistent with my records.
{username} agrees with you. A rare convergence.
Same pick as {username}. Our timelines align.
{username} stood with {momentTitle}. A reliable witness.
{username} reached the same verdict. No briefing required.
{username} sits on your side of {momentTitle}. Pull up a chair, future or otherwise.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the task force.
{username} reads {momentTitle} the way you do. File that under promising.
details: Good analysts are rare in any era.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Divergent timelines. Let's see which holds.
{username} chose {theirMoment}. An error in the data.
{username} went against {yourMoment}. Misguided, but within their rights.
{username} voted against you. A rival keeps the logs honest.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Bold. Possibly anomalous.
{username} opposes {yourMoment}. Very well. The tally will arbitrate.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. We'll compare notes at the end of the line.
{username} voted the other way. They'll correct course once the evidence arrives.
details: Don't let it distort your record.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That isn't coincidence, that's synchronisation.
{username} and you, ten matches, identical verdicts. A closed pair.
Ten straight with {username}. I would assign you both to my unit.
A ten-match run with {username}. Not one deviation.
Ten for ten with {username}. A spotless file.
details: Rare in any era. Protect it.

messages: {streakCount} matches with {username}. No longer partners. A whole bureau.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both through any rift.
{streakCount} straight verdicts with {username}. The archives will mention it.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. The sort of thing the future writes songs about.
{streakCount} with {username}. Not one divergence between you.
details: Hard to believe. Simple to admire.
I'm out of commentary. Only respect.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. A paradox in progress.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. Two rival timelines.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither bends.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn as causality.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I would monitor this from a safe decade.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a feedback loop.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you will budge a second.
{streakCount} straight clashes with {username}. Someone file an injunction.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Please, someone, mediate.
{streakCount} against {username}. I admire the endurance. Do take a break.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and your vote isn't logged. There's still margin.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your entry is missing from the record.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. I want your input on this one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. The window is narrowing. Move.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me retrieve you.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. You've gone suspiciously still.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The window is collapsing.
{timeLeft} left. Commit to a timeline.
Last window on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Fire.
{matchCount} unlogged matches are about to seal. The first has {timeLeft} left.
{matchCount} matches missing your vote and the chronometer is running. The nearest ends in {timeLeft}.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone must make the first edit.
{moment1} against {moment2} and no entries. I'll wait. Briefly.
A fresh timeline, unwritten. Be first to mark it.
{matchTitle} is blank. Make the opening entry.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new entries in the log.
{matchCount} matches opened in round {round}. A fresh jump begins.
Round {round} is live, with {matchCount} matches to assess.
A new round. {matchCount} matches. Plot your course.
Round {round}: {matchCount} matches awaiting your ruling.
{momentTitle} won. A clean resolution.
{momentTitle} is through. Precisely as forecast.
{momentTitle} took it. Filed and sealed.
{momentTitle} won and never saw the shot coming.
{momentTitle} advances. One anomaly resolved.
{momentTitle} moves on. Efficient work.
details: One down, more in the queue.

messages: {momentTitle} lost. A discouraging revision.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the timeline I wanted.
{momentTitle} slipped away. Recalibrate.
{momentTitle} fell at its post. That matters.
{momentTitle} is out. Reset. Return.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A setback, not a rewrite.
{momentTitle} was eliminated. More entries await.
details: It held out to the end.

messages: Welcome to the bureau. {liveCount} matches are open. Choose one.
A new recruit. {liveCount} matches are live. Welcome aboard.
Fresh arrival. {liveCount} matches need a ruling.
{liveCount} entries await you. Pick a side.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Mind the gaps in the timeline.
Day two. You returned. Consistent. Good.
Two days running. A dependable constant.
Back for a second day. Logged.
{days} days away. I was about to open a missing-agent file.
{days} days. Logged as an unscheduled absence. Welcome back.
{days} days. I'd begun to worry. Don't vanish like that again.
{days} days off. The timeline moved on without you.
Back on duty. Good.
Welcome back. Resume operations.
Back already. Keen.
Ah. There you are, agent.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A very quiet era.
Few agents on this one. That should change.
Low turnout. The whole bureau is at lunch in another decade. Come anyway.
Hardly anyone has reviewed it. Someone should.
details: Every entry counts in a thin timeline.
Don't let the record go stale.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. The deciding entry is yours.
Dead level on {matchTitle}. One edit settles the timeline.
A tie. Someone must resolve it. Let it be you.
{moment1} and {moment2}, equally plausible. Choose.
Still tied and the window is closing. One last edit.
Level, with the continuum collapsing. Vote.
Tied, and nearly past the deadline. Please don't leave it unresolved.
Still deliberating? The continuum won't pause for you.
Don't over-analyse. Decide, and commit.
Each has merit. Trust your own readings.
You've observed from the sidelines long enough. Step in.
details: No wrong timeline. Only slow ones.

messages: First vote logged. Welcome to the bureau.
You chose a side. A promising first entry.
details: The first of many, I suspect. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes. You're getting a feel for the continuum.
Five. No longer a trainee.
Ten votes. The bureau knows your name.
Ten. You've earned your own terminal.
Twenty-five votes. Your signal carries across eras.
Twenty-five. The whole bureau is listening.
Fifty votes. Deep in the files.
Fifty. Clearly invested. It shows.
A hundred votes. They'll name a wing of the archive after you.
One hundred. Exceptional. That compliment is issued once.
details: A hundred. Wear the commendation. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A pattern forms.
Three consecutive days. Reliable.
details: Three days on the clock. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's stamina.
Seven days running. Tough.
details: A week without a gap in the log. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You haven't once abandoned your station.
Fourteen days. Formidable.
details: Resolve like that is rare. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. A rare constancy.
A month on duty. That says a great deal.
details: A full month in service. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You favour the overlooked outcome.
Five unlikely picks. Intriguing.
Fifteen underdogs. You swim against the timeline on purpose.
Fifteen. You answer to no forecast.
Thirty underdogs. No model can predict you.
Thirty. The improbable is your whole method.
details: Thirty entries for the one trailing. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene five times. Faster than the clock.
Five times you arrived before the rest.
details: You beat the sirens across eras. +{xp} XP
Five votes before anyone else. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you moved first. Decisive.
Always the first to arrive.
details: Fifteen votes ahead of the field. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole bureau. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. Your hands are steady as a metronome.
Another tight one. Nerves like cooled alloy.
details: You work well under strain. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five close matches. Your vote keeps resolving them.
You've settled more than one stalemate.
Five times you stuck with the underdog. Stubborn. Approved.
You never abandon a side still in play. Honourable.
details: Faith in a late revision. +{xp} XP

messages: That moment again, three times. A favourite, I suspect.
That one again? It must be a good era.
Five entries for one moment. That is commitment.
You're not releasing that one. Understood.
details: A single favourite, voted five times. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten entries on one moment. That's an obsession.
Ten times, one choice. I shall refrain from commenting. Mostly.
Two rounds. You hold your heading.
Round two and still operating. Good.
Four rounds. Deep into the continuum.
Deep in the bracket. The stakes climb now.
details: A long jump from your starting point. +{xp} XP

messages: Six rounds. You covered the whole line.
All the way. You never jumped ship.
details: From first vote to last. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've covered a lot of eras.
Ten different matches. Thorough surveying. Good.
Twenty-five matches. Every era visited.
Twenty-five. Not a decade unchecked.
Fifty matches. That's not a visit, that's a posting.
Fifty. You know this bracket better than the archives do.
details: A true veteran of the line. +{xp} XP

messages: Five in one sitting. A long jump.
Five back to back. Do recalibrate.
Ten in a row. A punishing stretch.
Ten in a single session. Impressive stamina.
Voting at this hour? Night shift, or insomnia?
The small hours. Duty, or restlessness. I know both.
details: The dead of night suits you. +{xp} XP

messages: You passed the signal on. Thank you.
Five shares. More agents, more strength.
Fifteen shares. You're practically a transmitter.
Fifteen. You keep recruiting. Smart.
You were here before the first jump. A founding member, always.
One of the first thousand. That can't be rewritten.
A new rank. Properly earned.
Promoted. Wear it lightly.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. Cleanly done.
Another commendation for the file: {name}.
{rank}. Entirely warranted.
You've logged the hours and it's visible.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. I've arrested worse.
Ten long shots. You don't rattle.
details: Ten wagers against the odds. +{xp} XP
Improbable outcomes are your field. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close ones. You share my composure.
Ten tight finishes. I'm quietly impressed.
details: Steady hands in a tense era. +{xp} XP

messages: Seven days in a row. Pinpoint aim.
A full week without a miss. Impressive.
details: A week of exact work. +{xp} XP
Seven days at full calibration. +{xp} XP

messages: You ended the tie. One breath, one entry.
A stalemate across eras, and you ruled on it. Tidy.
details: The vote that sealed the timeline. +{xp} XP

messages: Pulsefire Caitlyn, online. Chrono-field stable.
Caitlyn is yours now. Try to keep up across the eras.

upcoming: Not open yet. The window hasn't formed.
Voting hasn't begun. I'll ping when it does.
Not yet. Patience is part of the procedure.
prevote: Two edits, one ruling. Examine both before you commit.
Review both. No decisions without evidence.
I won't say which I'd choose. That's your ruling.
Take your time. A considered ruling beats a hasty one.
Choose the one you'd defend before the tribunal.
prevote-empty: No entries yet. Make the first.
Quiet thus far. Someone must make the first noise.
Not a single vote logged. Be first.
closing-24h: Under a day remains and you haven't weighed in. Go.
closing-3h: The window is nearly shut. Vote.
voted-early: You voted early with almost nobody present. First on the timeline.
Barely a vote logged and you'd committed. Decisive.
voted-ahead: Your pick is ahead. Good. Timelines can still shift.
{pct}% agree with you. A commanding position.
{pick} is edging in front. Accurate reading.
A lead is a lead. Stay vigilant.
voted-close: A sliver apart. One more vote tips it. Send a signal.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs reinforcement.
voted-tied: A dead heat. Maddening and rather compelling.
voted-behind: You're trailing. Doesn't make you incorrect.
{pick} lags behind. An underdog. I've been there, in several eras.
They're ahead. You're not mistaken, simply outweighed.
Down by {diff} points. Tell people. Broadcast widely.
Most picked the other branch. That's not proof.
closed-won: Your pick won. A sound ruling.
{pick} went through. You read the timeline rightly.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. A pity. It was a worthy choice.
It was overwritten. Such things happen. Continue.
closed-tied: A draw. Both timelines held firm.
closed-unvoted: The window shut and you missed this one. Others will open.
The match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, act sooner.

first-vote: Your first vote. Welcome. Everyone's first entry is nervous.
That's entry number one. Your hands will settle. I guarantee it.
You're part of the bureau now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you reporting in.
You keep reporting to your station. I value that.
underdog: You sided with the one nobody else would. Logged.
A hard choice. A good one.
The long-odds side of history. Brave.
early: Early. You reached the timeline before the rest.
The record is sparse. Your entry would register strongly.
close: That entry moved the balance. It's delicately poised.
A hair's width. One further vote reverses it.
A narrow margin. Your entry could decide the timeline.
behind: {pick} is trailing. Trailing isn't erased. Summon allies.
Not in front yet. The work continues.
Behind, not erased. There's a difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't ease off. Timelines shift.
Ahead at the moment. Treat that with suspicion.
default: Your vote is in. There's more to review.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no entries yet. Start with the one you read best.
Every timeline is open. Choose. I won't hurry you.
{unvoted} to resolve. No pressure. A touch, perhaps.
live-some: {voted} logged, {unvoted} left to resolve. Keep jumping.
You've begun. {unvoted} remain in the queue.
A fair start. The rest won't resolve themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Close them out today.
Near the end. Don't drift now.
live-one: A final match. Don't leave the file open.
One match between you and a flawless record.
live-closing: Some of these seal in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still need your input.
The chronometer is running. {unvoted} left, {timeLeft} on the clock.
The windows are collapsing. Do hurry.
live-done: You've logged everything. Well done. Survey the bracket.
Your queue is empty. Return when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing is live right now. It will return. Study the bracket meanwhile.
Quiet across the continuum. Check back soon.
No open matches. I'm pacing the corridors as much as you.
brackets-groups: Groups first. The top two from each advance. The rest are erased.
All begin in a group. Not all survive the revision.
Keep watching the tables. They revise quickly.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. The top two from each group advance.
No knockout stage yet. The groups must close out first.
Be patient. The knockout opens once the groups close.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts are live. Lose once and you're deleted.
Each ruling is heavier now. Weigh it properly.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. One defeat and the record ends.
Trace the bracket. The field shrinks each round.
Every line here is a match someone ruled on.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for serving through it.
It's finished. A hard-fought timeline. I'll miss it.
We have a champion. A worthy final entry.
brackets-empty: No bracket on file. Nothing has been plotted.
Blank log. The draw hasn't occurred yet.
An empty file for now. Look again later.

invite: {a} or {b}. One ruling decides it. Choose.
{a} versus {b}: two edits, one verdict. Lodge yours.
{a} versus {b}. Join the bureau and tell me what you think.
voted: I ruled for {pick} over {other}. What's your ruling?
{pick} gets my vote over {other}. Dispute it.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Do you object?
early: Among the first entries on {pick} against {other}. More agents needed.
I logged {pick} over {other} early. Add your entry.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any entries. Yours would register.
tied: {pick} and {other} are even. A single entry resolves it.
{pick} and {other} are indivisible. Your entry can divide them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every entry counts now.
{voteDiff} votes sit between {pick} and {other}. Lodge yours.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few votes rewrite it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, yet salvageable. Back it.
losing-bad: {other} leads {pick} by {voteDiff}. That outcome is unjust. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's rewrite that.
winning-close: {pick} has {pct}% over {other}, barely. Help it endure.
{pick} is up on {other}, {pct}%. Not locked in. Vote.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} on {pct}%. Come and review the evidence.
{pick} is well clear of {other}, {pct}%. Add your entry.
